text: Hello, while on a B1 visa I was signed up with Leumit through my job. As soon as I got my a5 visa my employer told me they cancelled my insurance because now I can register as a resident. But my question is, do I need to register with Bituach Lumi or would I already be registered there? I have appointments with my doctors in Leumit and don't want to worry about them being cancelled or having to pay full price while I wait for my biometric ID to arrive.
